questions.scenario: It's time for 'Diwali ki Safai' and decorating the house.

options.text: I do the heavy lifting—shifting the sofas, climbing ladders to clean fans, and hammering nails.
I measure and reorganize the cupboards so everything fits perfectly in limited space.
I pick out the new beautiful curtains, arrange the fairy lights, and set up the aesthetic diyas.
I supervise my younger siblings, give them cleaning tasks, and manage the decoration budget.

questions.scenario: You are visiting an IKEA or a large furniture market (like Kirti Nagar).

options.text: I check the hinges, wood quality, and knock on the tables to see how strong they are.
I look at smart, foldable furniture and admire how they save space in small apartments.
I get inspired by their beautiful, fully decorated mock-rooms and color themes.
I check the price tags and calculate if assembling it myself is cheaper than paying a carpenter.

questions.scenario: Your parents hire a carpenter (Bhaiya) to make a new wardrobe in your room.

options.text: I stand with him, watch the cutting tools, and observe the physical process of building it.
I draw a detailed sketch showing exactly how many shelves and drawers I need inside.
I spend hours selecting the perfect aesthetic sunmica/laminate color for the outside doors.
I argue with him when he arrives late and make sure he finishes the work on time.

questions.scenario: You are playing a building game like Minecraft or The Sims.

options.text: I spend time gathering raw materials, digging, and constructing the core foundation.
I plan the floor layout logically, ensuring the kitchen and bedroom are placed perfectly.
I ignore the layout and spend all my time choosing wallpapers, rugs, and furniture styles.
I play in 'Survival Mode', managing my resources and gold carefully to build my empire.

questions.scenario: You walk into a brand new, luxurious cafe with your friends.

options.text: I look up at the ceiling to see how the AC ducts and lighting wires are installed.
I notice how comfortably the tables are spaced so waiters can walk easily without bumping.
I admire the aesthetic vibe, take aesthetic Instagram photos of the neon signs and plants.
I estimate how much money they spent on the interior and if the coffee prices justify it.

questions.scenario: You finally get your own separate bedroom! What is your first move?

options.text: I grab a toolkit, assemble my study table, and drill a shelf into the wall myself.
I measure the walls with a tape to figure out exactly where the bed will fit best.
I go on Pinterest to create an aesthetic mood board of led lights, posters, and bedsheets.
I negotiate a budget with Papa to buy new furniture from Amazon.

questions.scenario: When arranging your study desk before exams, you:

options.text: Fix the wobbly chair leg and adjust the physical height of the table.
Organize books and stationery in a highly logical flow so I can reach everything instantly.
Add a cute table lamp, an aesthetic pen stand, and a motivational poster.
I just clear the mess quickly so I can get down to the actual business of studying.

questions.scenario: Your family visits an under-construction flat they are planning to buy.

options.text: I walk carefully through the dust, looking at the cement work and bare brick walls.
I look at the 2D floor plan map and try to understand the Vastu and ventilation.
I close my eyes and visualize what color the walls should be and where the TV will go.
I listen to Papa negotiating the final price with the builder in the office.

questions.scenario: Every job has a frustrating part. Which of these can you tolerate?

options.text: Standing in a dusty, noisy room with laborers for 6 hours a day.
Redrawing a complex CAD layout 10 times because the client changed a wall size by 2 inches.
Searching through 100 fabric shops to find the exact shade of 'ocean blue' curtains.
Dealing with angry clients who complain that the project is delayed and over-budget.

questions.scenario: If you had a superpower in the design world, what would it be?

options.text: Instant Construction: I snap my fingers and the furniture builds itself perfectly.
X-Ray Vision: I can instantly calculate the dimensions and geometry of any empty room.
Color Magic: I can change the color and texture of any object just by touching it.
Mind Control: I can easily convince clients to approve my ideas and pay me double.

Site_Supervisor.title: Site Execution Engineer / Supervisor
Site_Supervisor.primary_match_text: You are a hands-on action taker! You don't like sitting in front of a laptop; you prefer being on the ground, working with tools, and making things physically happen.
Site_Supervisor.day_in_the_life: Standing on interior sites, guiding carpenters, electricians, and painters to ensure the designer's vision is built perfectly.
Site_Supervisor.alternative_match_text: Because of your love for physical execution and fieldwork, you would also excel as a Civil Engineer or Construction Manager.
Site_Supervisor.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a Diploma in Interior Design or B.Tech in Civil Engineering.

Space_Planner.title: Space Planner / CAD Layout Designer
Space_Planner.primary_match_text: You have a highly analytical and structural brain! You love optimizing things, solving spatial puzzles, and ensuring that every inch of a room is used logically.
Space_Planner.day_in_the_life: Creating precise 2D and 3D architectural layouts on AutoCAD, planning plumbing, electricals, and optimizing small apartment spaces.
Space_Planner.alternative_match_text: Your strong logical and structural thinking makes you an excellent candidate for core Architecture or Urban Planning.
Space_Planner.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Clear NATA/JEE and pursue a B.Arch (Bachelor of Architecture) or B.Des.

Interior_Decorator.title: Interior Decorator / 3D Visualizer
Interior_Decorator.primary_match_text: You are a pure creative soul! You have a beautiful sense of aesthetics, color, and you know exactly how to make a space feel warm, luxurious, and visually stunning.
Interior_Decorator.day_in_the_life: Selecting aesthetic color palettes, picking out furniture, buying fabrics, and creating realistic 3D renders of beautiful homes.
Interior_Decorator.alternative_match_text: Your high level of creativity also makes you a great fit for Set Design in movies, Event Decor, or Fine Arts.
Interior_Decorator.roadmap: Any stream in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Des in Interior Design or a specialized Diploma in Interior Decor.

Project_Manager.title: Interior Project Manager / Studio Owner
Project_Manager.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader and manager! You have an eye for design, but you prefer handling the business, controlling budgets, and getting the team to work efficiently.
Project_Manager.day_in_the_life: Meeting wealthy clients, negotiating material costs with vendors, managing deadlines, and running a profitable interior design firm.
Project_Manager.alternative_match_text: With your commanding nature and business mindset, you could easily transition into Real Estate Management or Startup Entrepreneurship.
Project_Manager.roadmap: Commerce or PCM in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA in Real Estate/Project Management, or B.Arch followed by an MBA.
